scenes.title: Grok Bot
scenes.sub: Always-on AI teammates from xAI, now a SpaceX division.
scenes.say: This is Grok Bot, from xAI, now a division of SpaceX. Grok Bots are always-on AI teammates.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Each Bot gets its own cloud computer
Works in parallel with other Bots
Checks back with you for approval
scenes.say: Each Bot gets its own cloud computer, signs into your apps, works in parallel with other Bots, and checks back with you before anything important.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: Every Bot runs on its own cloud computer
Desktop on macOS, Windows, Linux, or iOS
The backend picks the model for each job
scenes.say: It's hosted by xAI. You message your Bots from the desktop app or iPhone, and the backend picks the right model for each job automatically.

scenes.heading: Timeline
scenes.say: Grok Bot launched in beta on August 11, 2026, and Grok Bot for Enterprise followed on September 3.

scenes.title: VidiFlow
scenes.sub: Agent stacks that run your business at scale.
scenes.say: VidiFlow. Agent stacks that run your business at scale.
